Landing.betaText: EuroNova Version 1.0 — Currently operating in Orbital Public Beta.
Landing.title: Your passport to the European space.
Landing.subtitle: Discover accredited Erasmus+ youth exchanges, ESC volunteering deployments, and high-impact training seminars across 30+ European nations. Zero application fees, zero sponsored rankings, and 100% verified funding.
Landing.projectsInOrbitSub: Verified European mobility transmissions awaiting applicants
Landing.initiativeTitle: Built from Frustration. Engineered for Genuine European Solidarity.
Landing.initiativeDesc1: EuroNova was born out of raw, firsthand frustration with the chaotic state of European youth mobility. For years, ambitious young people have had to navigate sketchy WhatsApp groups, broken Instagram linktrees, expired Google Drive spreadsheets, and paid commercial agencies masquerading as volunteer coordinators. EuroNova is an open-source, non-profit digital gateway engineered by a single software developer and former Erasmus+ volunteer who believed that the youth of Europe deserved a world-class, centralized terminal without bureaucratic noise or gatekeeping.
Landing.initiativeDesc2: We operate with zero commercial paywalls, zero premium tiers, zero advertising tracking, and absolute editorial neutrality. We do not sell your personal data or charge hosting organizations to promote their listings. Every single opportunity displayed on our radar is an official European Commission-funded project where your accommodation, local meals, and international travel expenses are guaranteed by EU solidarity grants.
Landing.initiativeStaffTitle: Community-Led Moderation: Power to the Alumni
Landing.initiativeStaffDesc: Because EuroNova is a public utility, governance belongs to the community. Through our True Trust Protocol, active volunteers who reach Level 10 XP can submit an in-app clearance application to become official Community Moderators or Support Specialists. Staff members review flagged posts, assist newly arrived volunteers with transit guidance, and maintain a safe, welcoming digital space across all European languages.
Landing.youthTitle: Transform Your Passions into Fully Funded European Journeys
Landing.youthSubtitle: Whether your passion is documentary filmmaking, renewable energy, digital human rights, non-formal education, or circular fashion, there is an accredited European project designed for your growth. Meet fellow volunteers before you fly, coordinate flights, and explore Europe with complete peace of mind.
Landing.youthPoint1Desc: Erasmus+ and ESC projects are funded by the European Union. Your lodging (eco-hostels, rural retreats, youth centres), three nutritious daily meals, and project workshop materials are completely paid for. Furthermore, your round-trip international travel is reimbursed based on the European Commission's official distance-band calculator, including extra funding for Green Travel options like trains and buses.
Landing.youthPoint2Desc: Youth living in Europe's Outermost Regions — the Canary Islands, Azores, Madeira, Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, and Réunion — often face prohibitive flight costs. EuroNova features dedicated filtering and highlighted badges for projects offering enhanced travel grants for Outermost Regions, ensuring geographical isolation is never a barrier to European mobility.
Landing.youthPoint3Title: Connect Before You Fly & Raw Reviews
Landing.youthPoint3Desc: Never arrive alone. Our integrated squad channels and travel companion boards allow you to connect with other selected participants from your sending country before packing your bags. Coordinate shared flights, discuss rooming preferences, and read unedited, raw reviews from previous volunteers who lived with the hosting NGO.
Landing.orgsTitle: Secure Bridge & Aggregator for European Non-Profits
Landing.orgsSubtitle: EuroNova operates as a secure aggregator and discovery bridge. We auto-ingest official European mobility missions and direct motivated young Europeans straight to your verified external portals with zero intermediaries.
Landing.orgPoint1Desc: To protect youth and uphold the highest standard of safety, every organization registering on EuroNova must provide their official Organisation ID (OID) or Participant Identification Code (PIC), verified against European Commission registries. Unaccredited commercial agencies are permanently excluded.
Landing.orgPoint2Desc: EuroNova serves as the ultimate safe discovery hub, continuously ingesting official European Solidarity Corps and Erasmus+ transmissions. We filter out scam links and direct high-intent traffic across 30+ European nations straight to your accredited opportunities.
Landing.orgPoint3Title: Verified Application Routing to Your Portals
Landing.orgPoint3Desc: Post your verified opportunities and route highly motivated European youth directly to your official application forms or external portals. We provide massive, safe visibility while you keep your existing recruitment workflow.
Landing.featuresTitle: Engineered for Safety, Community & Real-World Impact
Landing.featuresSubtitle: EuroNova is not just a search directory. It is an end-to-end digital operating system built around four proprietary pillars designed to protect and support participants at every stage of their mobility.
Landing.featFaqDesc: Access over 120+ veteran-curated guides answering every question about Erasmus+ mobility: understanding Youthpass competencies, calculating distance bands, navigating European Health Insurance (EHIC) and Cigna insurance, securing Green Travel bonuses, and handling boarding pass reimbursements without bureaucratic headaches.
Landing.featForumDesc: A peer-moderated space where volunteers collaborate before departure. Find travel buddies across Europe, coordinate ground transit from remote airports, share luggage packing checklists, seek advice on dietary accommodations, and maintain lifelong international connections after returning home.
Landing.featTrustDesc: An algorithmic reputation protocol that permanently eliminates scams, impersonation, and harmful behavior. Users earn XP by completing verified profile dossiers, publishing genuine mobility reviews, and mentoring new applicants. High-XP volunteers unlock special privileges, anti-spam forum exemptions, and eligibility for staff moderation roles.
Landing.featSupportDesc: A dedicated, human-led dispute and support system. If a volunteer encounters host accommodation discrepancies, emergency travel issues, or project disputes, they can submit high-priority transmissions directly to our Support Specialists with real-time webhook telemetry and direct email notifications.
Landing.legalTitle: An Independent Labor of Love for the Youth of Europe
Landing.legalDesc: EuroNova is built in strict adherence to European democratic values, digital rights, and GDPR standards. We do not answer to corporate investors, venture capital, or advertisement networks. Our sole metric of success is the number of young people whose lives are transformed by funded international experiences.
Landing.donationsDesc: EuroNova is 100% free, forever. No paywalls, no premium tiers, no ads. We rely entirely on community donations to keep the servers running and the platform growing. If EuroNova helped you find your mission, consider supporting the infrastructure to keep this gateway open for the next generation of European explorers.
Landing.howToHelpTitle: How You Can Help Grow the Mission
Landing.howToHelpDesc: You don't need money to support EuroNova. Share the platform with youth centres, high schools, and universities in your region; report outdated project listings; contribute translations into your native European language; or reach Level 10 to join our volunteer support team.
Landing.legalDisclaimerDesc: EuroNova is an independent open-access digital initiative and is not officially affiliated with, endorsed by, or funded by the European Commission, EACEA, or any Erasmus+ National Agency. 'Erasmus+' and 'European Solidarity Corps' are registered trademarks of the European Union.

Footer.fiscalShieldDesc: EuroNova is an independent, non-commercial open-access initiative. Financial contributions made via Revolut, PayPal, or SEPA bank transfers are strictly voluntary peer-to-peer (P2P) personal gifts dedicated exclusively to cloud hosting and server sustainability. Contributions do not constitute a purchase, commercial sale, sponsorship, tax-deductible charitable donation, or binding service contract. No goods, digital services, or commercial benefits are exchanged. Donors explicitly waive commercial refund rights under EU consumer protection regulations, and EuroNova assumes zero tax or corporate fiscal liability for voluntary community contributions.

DonationBlock.story1: EuroNova is a completely free platform created from scratch by a single developer to eliminate barriers for European youth searching for Erasmus+ and European Solidarity Corps missions.
DonationBlock.story2: There are ZERO advertisements, ZERO subscription paywalls, and ZERO commercial sponsors. Contributions are strictly voluntary and 100% dedicated to keeping cloud servers, database backups, and telemetry scrapers alive.
DonationBlock.sepaDesc: Zero fee European bank transfer directly to the infrastructure account.
DonationBlock.revolutDesc: Instant peer-to-peer contribution via Revolut app or web link.
DonationBlock.paypalDesc: Card, debit, or PayPal balance support in any European currency.
DonationBlock.fiscalShieldTitle: P2P Fiscal & Legal Immunity Notice (Voluntary Infrastructure Support)
DonationBlock.fiscalShieldDesc: EuroNova is an independent, non-commercial open-access initiative. Financial contributions made via Revolut, PayPal, or SEPA bank transfers are strictly voluntary peer-to-peer (P2P) personal gifts dedicated exclusively to cloud hosting and server sustainability. Contributions do not constitute a purchase, commercial sale, sponsorship, tax-deductible charitable donation, or binding service contract. No goods, digital services, or commercial benefits are exchanged. Donors explicitly waive commercial refund rights under EU consumer protection regulations, and EuroNova assumes zero tax or corporate fiscal liability for voluntary community contributions.
DonationBlock.footerCommitment: EuroNova is committed to eternal free public access for volunteers and youth NGOs across Europe.
DonationBlock.footerThanks: Thank you for keeping our servers spinning ✨

LegalPrivacy.sec1Desc: The data controller responsible for the personal data processed through the EuroNova platform is:
LegalPrivacy.sec1LocationVal: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
LegalPrivacy.sec2Title: 2. Categories of Data Collected & Processing Purpose
LegalPrivacy.sec2Desc: EuroNova processes personal data solely to match young people with European mobility programs (Erasmus+, European Solidarity Corps, Youth Exchanges, and Training Courses):

LegalPrivacy.sec3Basis3Desc: Preventing fraudulent usage, mitigating denial of service, and safeguarding server security.
LegalPrivacy.sec4Desc: Your personal data is retained solely for as long as your account remains active on EuroNova.
LegalPrivacy.sec4WipeDesc: Users can permanently delete their account at any time via their profile settings (Profile > Danger Zone > Delete Account). This action triggers a complete, irreversible hard-wipe of all user data and project associations directly from our Supabase database.
LegalPrivacy.sec5Desc: EuroNova never sells or rents personal data to third parties. We rely on industry-leading cloud infrastructure providers:

LegalPrivacy.sec6Desc: Under European privacy laws, you hold the right to Access, Rectify, Erase, Restrict, and Port your personal data at any time.
